card.title: PlayStation 4 Diagnostic & Troubleshooting Guide for Power, BLOD, WLOD

claims.statement: If the console stays at 99mA standby current with no boot, the southbridge may be bad; check if the 32Khz crystal oscillates and replace the southbridge if missing.
claims.evidence: Standby boot sequence current draw and troubleshooting steps.
claims.quote: If it stays at 99mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is bad. Check the 32Khz crystal if it oscillates. If the 32Khz signal is missing, then replace the southbridge clean flux of the board.

claims.statement: A 6-second BLOD with a non-spinning fan points to a faulty southbridge.
claims.evidence: Symptom observation during blue light of death.
claims.quote: 6 second BLOD it will pulsing blue light for 6 seconds or it will stay a solid blue light for indefinitely period When fan is not spinning then the southbridge is faulty or if it spins and then stops spinning

claims.statement: Corrupted NOR flash memory can cause BLOD; desolder and validate/rebuild using the PS4 NOR Validator software.
claims.evidence: NOR flash diagnostic and repair procedure.
claims.quote: Corrupted NOR software. Desolder NOR chip, validate or rebuild the software using The PS4 NOR Validator software.

claims.statement: Error CE-35888-2 indicates a Renesas IC problem in the disc drive, which is typically unrepairable.
claims.evidence: Error code association with hardware fault.
claims.quote: Error CE-35888-2 While the disc drive itself may be functioning, encountering this error typically indicates a Renesas IC problem, which is not repairable.

procedure: Connect PIN 1 (+5VSB) and PIN 4 (+5VSB enable) of the power supply connector to a power supply set to +5V to monitor current draw and boot sequence.
Disconnect the hard drive and turn the console on to test if the hard drive is causing a BLOD issue.
Desolder the NOR chip and use the PS4 NOR Validator software to verify data integrity if NOR corruption is suspected.
Lift the main +12V coil to narrow down the shorted area if the +12V rail is shorted.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Do not touch hot components or handle a live board without proper precautions.
card.caveats: Not all BLOD symptoms share a single root cause; measurements must be verified against specific board revisions.
